WITH filtered_standings AS (
  SELECT driverId, points, wins
  FROM driverStandings
  WHERE points > 1.0
),
driver_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    driverId,
    AVG(points) as avg_points,
    AVG(wins) as avg_wins
  FROM filtered_standings
  GROUP BY driverId
),
overall_mean_wins AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as mean_wins
  FROM driver_averages
  WHERE avg_wins IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  da.driverId,
  da.avg_points,
  da.avg_wins,
  CASE 
    WHEN da.avg_wins IS NOT NULL
    THEN da.avg_wins - omw.mean_wins
    ELSE NULL
  END as difference
FROM driver_averages da
CROSS JOIN overall_mean_wins omw
WHERE omw.mean_wins IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
  difference IS NULL ASC,
  difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
